verdict.rationale: The pack documents no bulk or batch operation, either in the UI or in the API, for acting on many candidates or jobs at once. Migrating a spreadsheet of candidates means calling the per-candidate create endpoint repeatedly, which is a developer building block. Collection endpoints only list items, and posting one job to 200+ boards is a multi-destination publish rather than a bulk action across many items, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
